mapper.select: SELECT block_hash FROM block_hash WHERE chain_id = #{chainId} AND block_number = #{blockNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO block_hash (chain_id, block_number, block_hash, parent_hash, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{chainId}, #{blockNumber}, #{blockHash}, #{parentHash}, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT (chain_id, block_number) DO UPDATE SET block_hash = EXCLUDED.block_hash, parent_hash = EXCLUDED.parent_hash, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM block_hash WHERE chain_id = #{chainId} AND block_number < #{minKeep}
DELETE FROM block_hash WHERE chain_id = #{chainId} AND block_number > #{ancestor}
